expect_every.name: compose GPU median below 0.5 ms (4 x M5.2's 0.12 ms for the same rays), every complete cost-on window
sun shadows: clamped below one record per frame (window total), every complete chain-on window
local shadows: clamped below one record per frame, every complete chain-on window
refraction: clamped below one record per frame and no unusable copy, every complete chain-on window
game shadow: no invalid words, every complete chain-on window
scene wait: every cost window traces its own frame's scene (0 timeouts; stale shadows otherwise)
capacity: the RT capture drops no opaque draw (buffer full 0.00) in every traced cost window
capacity: the cascade casters buffer is never full (buffer full 0.0) in every traced cost window with the casters on
compose stability: no water frame left uncomposed (no on/off flip of the reflection and shadows), every complete compose-on window
expect_every.match: frames with a water pass [1-9]\d*, composed [1-9]\d*, uncomposed 0 \(on/off flips 0\)

expect_every.name: non-finite added by water 0: no record with a non-finite composed colour (kept the game's colour, counted), every complete compose-on window

expect_runner: \[motion-plan\] pointer centred in owned foreground game
purpose: M5 promotion, third water scene and the M5.4c check: S3 Campsite - 27h (outdoor day). Its pond under the log bridge is FLUID_Water_Plane_flowmap_PixelLighting_noCaustics_Shadows (06e66a6f), the family that samples the game's cascade sun shadow; it is mapped since M5.4c, with rt_water_game_shadow=1 at startup (112-B records). The 10-30 camp captures (20261030-163004, -163010) show it at about 1% of the frame (bottom centre); the pans widen it. Same plan as m5p2; rt_water_game_shadow follows rt_water_shadows (the sun step is the M5.4c swap here: lit water restored C + Dg, occluded R). Its precheck lines decide validity: the 06e66a6f patch with Vg, a variant drawing, game-shadowed records with no invalid words. Local-light and refraction participation are reported, not required.
